requirements: R1: Add docker-compose.yml at the repository root to start the full stack
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for launch verification

slices.title: Add docker-compose and health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization for this epic, I want to create a docker-compose file and health check, so that the stack can be run and verified locally
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clone of the repository, When I run docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the stack is running, When I ping the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a healthy status.
Given a local test environment, When running the integration tests, Then the docker-compose setup is verified to start properly.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time to under 5 minutes

requirements: R1: Add UI controls to update existing materials
R2: Add UI controls to delete existing materials

slices.title: Add update and delete UI for materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the update and delete UI for this epic, I want to add edit and delete actions, so that materials can be managed without outdated entries
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material, When the user clicks edit and saves changes, Then the frontend invokes the PUT API and updates the view.
Given an existing material, When the user clicks delete, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API and removes it from the view.
Given the frontend test suite, When running E2E and component tests, Then the update and delete UI interactions are verified to function correctly.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to update or delete a material to under 30 seconds

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated access to the catalog and material creation
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in

slices.title: Implement authentication blocks and login prompts
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to block unauthenticated access and show a login prompt, so that only authorized users can manage the catalog
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog, Then they are blocked.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they are blocked, Then they are prompted to log in.
Given the security test suite, When running integration and E2E tests, Then unauthenticated access attempts are proven to be rejected.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% block rate for unauthenticated material creation attempts
